topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer progression is driven by the Darwinian selection of genetic mutations and alterations in the epigenetic landscape.

topics.label: Cancer stem cells and cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the stem cell hierarchy model and evaluate experimental evidence regarding the cell of origin in different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental regulation, inflammation, and stromal support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory microenvironmental signals and supportive stromal cells promote tumor growth and offer avenues for therapy.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the genomic, transcriptomic, and computational techniques used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multi-factorial framework of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic alterations, cell-of-origin characteristics, and microenvironmental factors jointly drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
